config.valid_variable_day: >=1 stored issuance; single-issuance days counted as unrevised in Part 1 denominators (H0002 convention, mirrored)
config.revision_definition: first-issued value != final-issued value, Decimal-quantized to 0.01 (construction/rounding frozen -- see decimal_policy below); any-revision indicator per variable-day; first = min(issuance_time), final = max(issuance_time)
config.attribution_rule: revised tmin day is post-midnight-attributed iff the earliest issuance whose quantized value equals the final value has local(issuance_time) >= 00:00:00 America/New_York on observation_date + 1 day; issuance_time interpreted as naive-UTC (verified, see reproducibility_verification); unresolved cases remain in denominator as non-attributed -- PREREG Sec 4
config.decimal_policy: float->Decimal construction via Decimal(str(v)) only, never Decimal(v); value quantization to 0.01 via ROUND_HALF_EVEN; round-trip invariant (|float(quantized) - raw_float| < 1e-6) checked under gate G2, violation aborts -- AMENDMENT Finding 3
config.estimand_1: D = p_tmin - p_tmax (proportion of revised variable-days); positive = tmin revises more
config.estimand_2: p_pm = X_pm / R_tmin (proportion of revised tmin variable-days post-midnight-attributed)
config.ci_method_estimand_1: Newcombe (1998) hybrid score interval for a difference of independent proportions, no continuity correction, two-sided 95% -- PREREG Sec 6.1
config.ci_method_estimand_2: Wilson score interval, no continuity correction, two-sided 95% -- PREREG Sec 6.1
config.exact_arithmetic: integer counts; Fraction proportions; Decimal precision-50 interval bounds; all strict decision comparisons after 1e-12 ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantization of both operands; quantized equality never satisfies a strict inequality -- PREREG Sec 6.2
config.pairing_treatment: decisional interval unpaired per the frozen H0011 entry (audit-approved, PREREG Sec 12 R6); the non-decisional paired-Newcombe robustness check is removed -- AMENDMENT Finding 2
config.decision_rule: 1) any gate fails -> EXECUTION BLOCKED; 2) L(D) <= 0 -> Rejected; 3) L(D) > 0 and L(p_pm) > 1/2 -> Confirmed; 4) L(D) > 0 and U(p_pm) < 1/2 -> Rejected (mechanism refuted); 5) L(D) > 0 and interval straddles 1/2 -> Inconclusive -- PREREG Sec 7.1
config.random_seed: not applicable -- fully deterministic, no resampling

config.part_2_scope_statement: This result is evidence about settlement-label formation timing only -- that revised daily-minimum labels typically reach their final value in a post-midnight issuance. It does not identify the timing of the underlying physical temperature event (when the true daily minimum occurred), because this dataset carries issuance timestamps only, not occurrence timestamps. A study identifying the physical mechanism would require new occurrence-time data (e.g. parsed from raw CLI product text) and would constitute a separate, future hypothesis, not a re-interpretation of this one. -- AMENDMENT Finding 1; must be reproduced verbatim adjacent to any Confirmed Part 2 report
